name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-06-30, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
